description:
The Radix DJ frame is now available for custom builds. Constructed of trusted 4130 chromoly, the Radix frame is designed to be simple, stiff, strong, and ready for action.

Details

CNC machined integrated 1.5” tapered headtube for maximum strength and greater fork compatibility.

100% chromoly tubing w/ top and bottom gussets at headtube junction.

Brazed cable guides. Braze-on’s use low temp to not interfere with tube strength.

Reinforced rear stay at disc brake to prevent flex.
